otes, paper pages, calendar tasks, drawings and a reusable prompt library on one desk inside DSH.
中文
> panel plugin v0.6.2
## Overview
Paper Isle is a sidebar panel plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It puts a personal desk into the left pan
el: **sticky notes, paper pages, calendar tasks, drawings and a reusable prompt library** live in on
e place, windows move and resize freely, everything saves itself, and the data never leaves your mac
ce, windows move and resize freely, everything saves itself, and the data never leaves your machine.
It stays quiet on purpose: no floating toasts, no empty status rows, a theme that follows DSH, and a
dark mode rebuilt for paper. It is for people who want a local, offline, exportable workspace witho
ilt for paper. It is for people who want a local, offline, exportable workspace without leaving DSH.
## Features
### Two skins, one product
Since 0.6.0 there are two skins with identical features, only the look differs: **Paper Isle Classic
** (`classic`, the default for existing workspaces — paper surface, handwriting, freely placed notes
) and **Native Glow** (`modern` — no tape, stamp or paper grain; a very light blue-violet / teal amb
ience; DSH-native tokens; sticky notes become an ordered grid you can drag, or reorder with `Alt + ←
; DSH-native tokens; sticky notes become an ordered grid you can drag, or reorder with `Alt + ←/→`).
Switch in Settings → Appearance → "Desk look". It applies instantly without a page reload; windows,
unsaved edits, search terms, the selected calendar day and the current drawing page all survive. A f
resh install asks once, each upgrade asks once more, and "Don't remind me again" stops it for good.
### Sticky notes
- Short thoughts, saved automatically; **the whole sheet can be dragged** (except the body text, scr

ollbar, colour swatches and delete button), and the one you touched last stays on top.
- The body us
es the bundled **LXGW WenKai** handwriting face; you can switch to a system face or a paper serif in

Settings.
- **The trash keeps notes for 7 days** instead of showing an undo toast — deleted notes l
and in the trash at the top of the sticky window and can be put back at any time. Empty notes are dr
t the top of the sticky window and can be put back at any time. Empty notes are dropped immediately.
### Paper pages

- Long-form writing with a searchable page list on the left and auto-save.
- A new page's title is a

placeholder, not a line of literal "Untitled page".
- **Pinning**: the editor toolbar has Pin / Unp
in with `aria-pressed`; pinned pages sort first, the rest stay newest-first. Pinning survives reload
, export/import and migration.
### Calendar and tasks
- Every task has **four urgency levels** (urgent and important / important / urgent / none), switche

d **in place** on the task row without opening a detail dialog.
- **Calendar dots**: unfinished dots
sit under the day number and take the level colour; finished dots sink to the bottom of the cell an

d turn neutral.
- **Persistent tasks**: a "daily" task reappears once a day from its anchor date; ch
ecking in today grows a new unfinished instance tomorrow, while the calendar only shows days you act
ually checked in. Future dates are never pre-filled. Finishing the run shows "this one is done", sto
ps new instances and can be restored at any time.
### Prompt library and composer entry
- **Library**: the fifth dock app, seeded with five sample prompts. Search and pin from the list, ed
it title and multi-line body on the right, auto-saved. Body limit 20,000 characters, up to 300 promp

ts. New / duplicate / pin / delete, with confirmation on delete.
- **Use it while chatting**: every
composer has a small "Prompts" button on the left of its tool row. It opens a list above the input;
`↑↓` selects, `Enter` fills, `Esc` closes. **It only fills the draft**: an empty draft receives the
whole prompt, a non-empty one gets an insert at the caret (single-step undo); a sending composer ask
s you to try again in a moment. It never writes the system prompt and never sends by itself.
### Drawing paper
- Freehand drawing with undo/redo, eraser, brush colours and four tip sizes, clear page, delete whol
e page and export to PNG; the booklet flips left/right and remembers the current page.
### Desk, windows and dock
- **Today card** on the right of a wide desk so windows never cover it; it steps aside on narrow pan

els.
- **Dock**: the only entry point to the apps; click toggles a window; **icons can be dragged to
reorder** (or `Alt + ←/→` when focused; the order is remembered and can be reset in Settings → Appe

arance). The house button gathers every window, and pressing it again restores them.
- **Clicking em

pty desk** also gathers all windows into the dock (nothing is destroyed).
- **Commands and apps**: t
he first item in Settings, reachable with `Ctrl/Cmd + K`; search apps, pages or actions, `↑↓` to sel

ect, `Enter` to run.
- **Windows**: Classic has no minimise / maximise / close triple; drag the titl
e bar to move and the bottom-right corner to resize; close with `Esc`, `Ctrl/Cmd + Alt + W` or the c
ommand list. Native Glow adds explicit minimise and close buttons in the title bar, wired to the sam

e window manager actions.
- **First-run tour**: six steps, replayable from Settings → Tutorial.
## Compatibility

- Built against DSH **0.2.1-rc.2**.
- Tested on Windows 11 with DSH 0.2.1-rc.2: install, sidebar, pa

nel, data retention across reload and view switches, host persistence, export/import.
- CI builds an
d runs the page contract, DOM nesting, host route and client syntax checks on **Windows, macOS and U

buntu** runners.
- **Not yet exercised on a real macOS or Linux DSH**: the data path uses `DSH_HOME`
or `~/.dsh` and there are no platform-specific binaries. Please open an issue if something breaks.
- Chinese and English pages are built from one source; sample content is generated in the language o
f first creation, and your own text is never translated.
